complementaryRelationships.description: Both specifications enforce the same architectural pattern - metrics calculations must happen in RPC API, not in OpenCode client

complementaryRelationships.spec1: Activity Execution Recording and Metrics Feedback Loop
complementaryRelationships.description: Thompson sampling parameters (alpha/beta) are updated by our metrics aggregation. Execution recording provides the data Thompson sampling needs to function.
complementaryRelationships.resolution: Execution recording triggers update_metrics_after_execution() which updates Thompson parameters server-side
complementaryRelationships.impact: POSITIVE - Unblocks Thompson sampling learning system
